name: Multi-parameter Regularization with Center-Axis Constraint
aliases: Multi-Parameter Regularized Inversion for Axisymmetric Tomography
definition: A reconstruction framework for axisymmetric sprays that combines global smoothness penalty (second-order Tikhonov) with a center-axis constraint (zero-gradient condition) to stabilize the inverse reconstruction of extinction coefficient and radiative source term from IR radiance data.
